topic: Atomic Structure and Periodic Table Representations
key_concepts: Electron cloud model represents electrons around the nucleus
Orbital level model shows electrons arranged in energy levels
Atoms are described by protons, neutrons, and electrons
Atomic number equals the number of protons
Number of neutrons can be found from atomic mass and atomic number
Group number and period number relate to an element's electron arrangement
Highest occupied energy level can be used to color-code periodic table regions
Lewis dot diagrams represent valence electrons of an element
Beryllium, boron, and carbon have specific subatomic particle counts
